question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (2)
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate preposition to use with years is **"in."**
 
• The phrase should correctly read **"in 2022."**
 
 
• **They met *in *1885**
 
• **They moved to the U.S.* in* 2019.**
 
 
 
• The appropriate word for fill in the blanks no. 2 is 'in.'

​​Hence, the correct sentence from the passage should read** "****The concentrations of greenhouse gases (GHG) that trap heat in the Earth's atmosphere rose to record levels in 2022, __according to the GHG bulletin released by the World Meteorological Organisation (WMO) on November 15, 2023."**

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** *Other options (**"of," "at," "on"**) do not fit the context of specifying the year. As they are not appropriate preposition to be placed before any years.
